3M-UI · 前端资源未嵌入

此二进制由 go build 直接编译，未包含打包好的 Web 前端。请先构建前端并替换嵌入目录：

cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
rm -rf backend/cmd/server/web/dist
cp -r frontend/dist backend/cmd/server/web/dist
cd backend && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags sqlite_modernc -o ../../3m-ui ./cmd/server

或直接执行 make build-linux（其 frontend-assets 目标会自动完成上述步骤）。详见 README「从源码构建」。

This binary was built without the web frontend. Build the frontend and copy it into backend/cmd/server/web/dist before compiling (see the Makefile frontend-assets target or the README).
